{{Quote|Never trust a Thyrsian to do the proper job of a Mandalorian|[[Rex/Legends|Rex]] shortly after the [[Battle of Skye]]|<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
'''Tark Squad''' was an elite [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] that existed as part of the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The four members of the squad were [[Thyrsian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] trained by [[Sarsius Torne]], a [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]] [[Sun Guard]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] believed they were trained on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] like the other commandos, but they had actually been trained in the [[Dark Worlds]] before the mad [[mutant]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Zeta Magnus]] inserted them into the Grand Army of the Republic with the help of [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|SBI]] agent [[Trachta]]. The clones had [[Cyber-mnemonic implant|cybernetic control bands]] that made them remorseless and obedient. The members of Tark Squad may have been clones of Sarsius. Tark is the Thyrsian word for "Four".

==Members==
===Nilo===
{{Quote|Our armor is environmentally controlled, General.|[[Nilo (clone commando)|Nilo]] to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi Wan]] on [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|Katarn Armor]]|<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story" />}}
Nilo wore a pauldron that distinguished him from the rest of Tark Squad. His name was also the Thyrsian word for "Zero". Nilo greatly favored the term "optimal" over other informal clone slang for positive assessments. Ironically, at the end of his life, Nilo was vaporized by a [[Class-D detonator]].

===Xoni===
{{Quote|Not a bad thing|[[Xoni]] when discussing his opinion on the possibility of having a Thysrian [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] army instead of a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clone army with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan]] |<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story" />}}
Xoni's name was the Thyrsian word for "One".

===Quo===
{{Quote|A little help, sir?|[[Quo]] to [[Halagad Ventor]] as they navigate the [[Entyrmion]] cave|<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story" />}}
[[Quo]]'s name was the Thyrsian word for "Two".

===Kupe===
{{Quote|Sirs, why don't Jedi just fly?|[[Kupe]] to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin]] and [[Halagad Ventor]] while scaling a mountain|<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story" />}}
Kupe wore standard clone commando armor with a silver finish like the majority of his squad. He had a great fascination with Jedi and their force abilities, often asking his [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi commanders]] questions about the Jedi. Kupe's name was the Thyrsian word for "Three".
